{{Quote|Many, many years ago...when I was a much younger man...my daughter, Felicia, was kidnapped. She was the most precious thing in the galaxy to me, and yet she was snatched away.|[[Wernell Covington]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:V" />}}
'''Felicia''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who until her tragic death, was the daughter of [[Wernell Covington]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Despite attempts to pay the ransom and the best efforts of law enforcement officers, the entire ordeal went badly. Very badly. Felicia was killed. She was jettisoned into space from the starship on which she was being held.|Wernell Covington, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:V" />}}
[[File:WernellCovington.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wernell Covington, Felicia's father.]]
Felicia was the daughter of [[Wernell Covington]], a wealthy land owner who lived on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a moon of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> Sometime during the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="TQC" /> Felicia was kidnapped for ransom. The kidnapping was planned and organized by the criminal known as [[Vladlun Travan]]. However, attempts to pay the ransom ended badly, culminating in Felicia's [[Death/Legends|death]]. The poor girl was jettisoned into space from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on which she was being held.<ref name="SWG:V" />

Wernell Covington was deeply traumatized by the awful fate of his daughter and he vowed his life to avenge his daughter, personally killing most of her kidnappers. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Covington's age and diminishing wealth forced him to hire a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate the remaining two perpetrators.<ref name="SWG:V" /> Almost three decades after Felicia's death,<ref name="TQC" /> the spacer finally killed the last two kidnappers, Vladlun Travan and [[Jurgen Nath]], allowing Covington to live out his days in peace.<ref name="SWG:V" />

==Behind the scenes==
Felicia was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:V" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Felicia was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
